features:
MUFFIN AND QUICK BREAD MIX: Naturally and artificially flavored banana nut muffins made with real California walnuts are home baked treats that are quick for families on the go

CONVENIENT AND EASY: Simply follow the package directions to stir together water, vegetable oil, and eggs, then bake

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare this muffin and bread mix as a delicious part of breakfast or brunch; Explore Betty Crocker dessert recipes for more tasty inspiration the whole family will love

MOIST AND FLUFFY MUFFINS: Kids and adults will love the taste of baked, moist and fluffy banana nut muffins; Serve baked muffins as sweets for celebrations, office treats, birthday parties, baked goods gift baskets, and more

CONTAINS: Twelve Betty Crocker Banana Nut Muffin and Quick Bread Mix, Made with California Walnuts, 12.3 oz
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Walnut Pieces, Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Modified Corn Starch, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Toasted Wheat Germ, Corn Starch, Monoglycerides, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
